💡 The novelty lies in a one-step lithiothermic symbiosis creating built-in LiF nanocrystals twinned with Li2S within graphene capsules, enabling fast Li-ion transport and polysulfide confinement. This enables high-areal-capacity (6.3 mAh cm–2) Li2S cathodes under lean electrolyte and thin-Li conditions, and anode-free cells retaining 650 mAh g–1 after 100 cycles—advancing practical anode-less/free Li–S batteries.

💡 The novelty lies in converting sacrificed Al layers of V2AlC MAX into functional AlF3 nanoparticles via gas-solid reaction, achieving simultaneous MXene conversion and interfacial functionalization. item.title: Dual‐Anion‐Regulated Localized Weakly Solvating Electrolyte Via Trace Additive for Wide‐Temperature 4.5 V Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using a trace LiDFBOP additive to suppress DFOB⁻-rich aggregates, creating a dual-anion CIP-dominated weakly solvating electrolyte. This molecular-level solvation regulation builds robust B/F/P-containing interphases on both electrodes, enabling 4.5 V lithium metal batteries from −10°C to 75°C. Significance: stable lean-electrolyte, lean-Li cycling in Li||LMFP, NCM811, LCO cells and Ah-level pouch cells, outperforming reported strategies.

item.title: Bimodal Pore Engineering of Mesoporous Carbon onto Ti3C2T x via a Soft–Hard Templating Route for Highly Durable Potassium-Ion Batteries
item.description:
کربن مزوپور دووجهی N,P-doped به‌صورت درجا روی Ti3C2Tx MXene رشد داده شد و به‌عنوان آند باتری یون پتاسیم ظرفیت بالا و پایداری چرخه‌ای ۳۵۰۰ چرخه‌ای نشان داد.
Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a phytic acid-mediated soft–hard dual-templating route that in situ grows N,P-co-doped bimodal mesoporous carbon on Ti3C2Tx MXene, using PA as a molecular bridge to orchestrate coassembly. This yields durable potassium-ion battery anodes with high capacity (303.6 mAh g–1) and ultra-stable cycling (148.3 mAh g–1 after 3500 cycles), enabled by a stable inorganic-rich SEI.
🏷 potassium-ion battery · Ti3C2Tx MXene · mesoporous carbon · bimodal pores · solid electrolyte interphase

Materials Horizons | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a crosslinkable PEDOT:PSS-based binder that couples electron/Li+ transport with interfacial engineering, addressing the trade-off between mechanical stability and ionic/electronic conduction in Si anodes. Its significance is enabling Si anodes to accommodate large volume expansion while maintaining efficient charge transport, a key step toward high-performance, long-life lithium-ion batteries.
